externality.interpretation: Rows with later logged arrivals are confounded by subsequent interference. Even no-later-arrival rows validate only the selected-world target prediction; baseline counterfactuals require a fixed-snapshot replay or paired run.

iterationStateCoverage.interpretation: Zero mixed-state rows mean this run exercised the clean-snapshot gate; held-out calibration, not this workload, tests additive decode-plus-prefill batching.

limitations: Scheduler admission, scheduled batch contents, and pure engine iteration duration are not directly observable without vLLM instrumentation.
Decode dispatch-to-first-event includes queueing, transfer synchronization, engine work, HTTP, and proxy buffering.
SSE event gaps are token proxies; one event may contain zero, one, or multiple model tokens.
An aggregate NIXL delta is request-attributed only for a single-transfer measurement window.
A single selected execution cannot reveal the realized counterfactual resident externality.

transferAttribution.rule: A NIXL metric window is attributed only when successfulTransfersAfter-successfulTransfersBefore equals one.
